title: Rationale for Barring Women Above 45 Years Old from Receiving IVF Treatments
what_it_is: Rationale for Barring Women Above 45 Years Old from Receiving IVF Treatments

sections.label: Age and cycle limits
sections.summary: The age limit for AR procedures including IVF is 45, with 10 fresh cycles for women aged 40 and below and five for women above 40.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To protect patients’ interests, the current age limit for AR procedures, including in-vitro fertilisation (IVF), is set at age 45.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In addition, the current IVF limit is set at 10 fresh cycles for women aged 40 and below, and five fresh cycles for women above 40.

sections.label: AR success rates by age
sections.summary: AR success rates fall from 17.1% for women aged 35 to 39 to under 7% for ages 40 to 44 and about 4% at 45 and above.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In fact, for AR success rates, it falls sharply at age 40, from 17.1% for women of ages between 35 and 39, to less than 7% for women from age 40 to 44.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: And then it falls further to about 4% for women aged 45 and above.

sections.label: Reviewing AR limits
sections.summary: The limits are regularly reviewed, taking into account AR technological advancements, professional standards of care and other patient factors, with announcements if changed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Notwithstanding this, as I have also said, we recognise that there have been recent advancements made in AR technology that have actually improved the safety of AR procedures in general, we regularly review these limits and will take into account such technological advancements as well as professional standards of care and other patient factors.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, we will make the announcements if we decide to change these limits.

sections.label: IVF appeal considerations
sections.summary: About 50 patient appeals for IVF are received yearly over the last five years, considering the female patient's medical conditions, maternal age and previous fresh cycles.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: I was wondering if the Senior Minister of State could share with the House for those appeals for IVF, what are some of the considerations that the Ministry takes into account when evaluating the appeals?

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We received about 50 patients' appeal per year over the last five years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Some of the factors we take into account will be the medical conditions of the female patient, the maternal age, as well as the number of fresh cycles that she had previously undergone.
